tooltip: Manhattan -log10(P) uses the paper's definition (re-introduced GGPv3 sites excluded). Body weight chr14 exact value: -log10(P)=441.3 at BovineSNP50 SNP chr14:25,307,116 (two-sided P=5.03e-442, ~4.97e-442 in the Fig. 1 legend); re-introduced GGPv3 causal SNP chr14:25,015,640 would give -log10(P)=480.2 (480.2 vs 441.3 difference).

meta.rule: Exact -log10(P) from Z via scipy.special.log_ndtr (unclipped); all hits with -log10(P)>=5.0 capped at top 3 per 20-kb bin; background minimum-P per 25-kb bin for 2.5<=-log10(P)<5.0 and per 125-kb group of 25-kb winners for -log10(P)<2.5; <=24k points/trait (<=48k points/model, <500 KB gzipped).
